title: A signal for milk release
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: Oxytocin promotes milk ejection by acting on myoepithelial cells. It is produced in the hypothalamus and released from the posterior pituitary.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which hormone released from the posterior pituitary promotes milk ejection? Oxytocin promotes milk ejection by acting on myoepithelial cells. It is produced in the hypothalamus and released from the posterior pituitary.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.
